faq.a: Gary is the artist behind SingIt Pop. He's a prolific creator who uses music as therapy and expression. Despite being deaf in one ear and his other ear fading, he continues to 'Keep Singing It POP', blending pop, country, and EDM.

faq.q: How do I become a VIP?
faq.a: Visit the Membership page. The VIP tier costs £8.99/month or you can opt for Lifetime access.
Fan (Free), Insider (£3.99/mo), and VIP (£8.99/mo). Insiders get MP3 downloads and playlists. VIPs get 20% off merch, Lossless WAV downloads, and exclusive Radio stations.
VIP and Label members automatically get 20% off all physical merch. Use the code VIP20 at checkout on our fourthwall shop.

faq.q: How do I license music for my project?
faq.a: Visit our Licensing Page. We offer Creator (£49), Commercial (£199), and Extended (£1,000+) licenses to fit any project size.

faq.q: Do Custom Songs include commercial rights?
faq.a: Standard 'Jingle' and 'Full Song' packages are for Personal Use only. For commercial campaigns, please select the 'Premium Commercial' tier or use our Licensing Catalog.

We have the Midnight Hoodie, Signature Heavy Tee, Studio Cuffed Beanie, Vinyl Carrier Tote, Studio Dad Hat, and Midnight Coffee Mugs. We also offer Ringtones, Digital Artbooks, Mixtapes, and Creator Packs in the Shop.

faq.q: How do I gift a Digital Mixtape?
faq.a: For only £10, you can pick 5 tracks from any album and write a personalized dedication. Perfect for birthdays or special moments. Your friend will receive a unique, cinematic playback link. Build one in the Mixtape Builder.

For only £5, you can own a high-resolution Digital Artbook for any album in our discography. Each book includes full lyrics, production notes, and exclusive studio photography. Get them in the Digital Bookstore.

faq.q: What is the Studio V13 Creator Pack?
faq.a: Our flagship product for creators and editors. For £20, you get a professional suite of surgically harvested, 100% vocal-free stems, melodic intros, and cinematic stingers from our master studio projects. Available in the Shop.
If you are an Insider or VIP, go to any Album page. You will see 'MP3' or 'WAV' download icons next to the tracks.
The FanZone is where you can create your own Mixes (Playlists) and enter community contests. Insiders can publish their own mixes directly to the site!
We have several stations including Main, Deep Cuts, Demos, and Live. VIPs get access to all stations for the ultimate 'Inside the Studio' experience.

We offer three premium sponsorship tiers for each track:
• Gold: Your name permanently on the track page + Official Badge.
• Platinum: Prominent placement + Official Badge + Early access to the next Single.
• Diamond: Top Billing as 'Executive Producer' + Exclusive Animated Badge + Early access + Lifetime 10% Merch Discount.

faq.q: How can I track my license?
faq.a: Once you purchase a license, it is registered in our master database. You can request your official PDF certificate which includes your unique License Number and the current issue date for legal proof of use.
Yes! We have a dedicated Ringtones Page featuring exclusive snippets of the latest drops and vault tracks.
Our global analytics now tracks visitor geography in real-time. We have fans from all over the world, with deep data on country-level engagement (Visits by Country) visible in our admin dashboard.

faq.q: How can I support Gary directly?
faq.a: You can use the new Tip the Artist feature! Just click the 'Heart' icon next to any track in the music library to send a small tip (£1, £5, £10, or £25). 100% of tips go directly toward studio time and future song production.

faq.q: What is the Free Welcome Gift?
faq.a: New fans who join the club for free get an instant high-resolution track download as a 'Thank You'. It's our way of welcoming you to the SingIt Pop family!
